infobox.effect: Adds map of local area Customs

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Customs plan map (Customs) is a map in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A paper plan map of the vast Customs premises. Not the most up-to-date copy, but it's better than nothing.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The map is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Functionality
sections.text: On the map you are able to place up to 100 icons and notes of 4 varieties.
